test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. Select the option 'no correction required' if the sentence is correct as given.**

(**They was standing**) at one end of a very long and splendid hall.
solution:
The correct answer is **"They were standing."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 

__
 
• The error in the sentence** "They was standing at one end of a very long and splendid hall"** is the subject-verb agreement.
 
• **"They"** is a plural pronoun, but the verb **"was"** is singular.
 
• The correct form should be **"were"** to match the plural subject** "They."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

**Correct sentence**: ***They were standing**__ at one end of a very long and splendid hall.*
